card.name: Start of a capitalized name part
card.fires_on: Fires on the first letter or two of a name that continues in the next piece, such as the R in Lactated Ringer's, the D in Dextrose, or the O in Omeprazole. Also fires on the single word I and on the period in M. D. Anderson.

modes.label: Split drug and fluid names
modes.description: A single capital letter or short start of a drug or fluid name that is completed by the next piece.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly unrelated foreign-language pieces, so there is no clear effect beyond a weak push away from name continuations.
card.plain: It marks the very start of a name that is still being spelled out, like the R of Ringer's or the D of Dextrose.
